verdict_reason: GOV.UK inset and client module are wired correctly and the inset is covered end to end, but the new hidden page input that keeps a refused save on its page has no test.

todos.issue: The new hidden 'page' input (template.njk:20) is what keeps a refused save on the page the trader was on: postedPickerState reads payload.page (picker-routes.js:29) for the not-in-book 400 and the save-failure 500 re-renders. No test posts a page: the only page values in the picker tests are GET query strings (paging-test-support.js:13, :69) and href checks. Deleting line 20 turns nothing red, and a refused save on page 2 would silently drop back to page 1.
todos.fix: Must: a test fails when a refused save posted from a later page re-renders any page other than that one. One way: in paging-test-support.js, post { page: '2', selected: <id not in the book> } to a picker holding more than 8 addresses and assert the 400 response serves page 2 and its hidden page input holds 2.
